mira: Quick PR incoming: tiny troubleshooting note for 429/timeouts when context limits cause evictions. Will include a 2-line Python SDK retry snippet + curl check.

sam: Please call out concrete backoff and a max attempts. Ops prefers numbers.

mira: Recommend expo backoff start=250ms, max=4s, jitter; max_attempts=3. Also call out checking Retry-After header and an X-Context-Evicted hint in body/headers.

doc-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5133 (labels: err-ref, 429).

jordan: Add one-liner about Dedicated vs Hosted concurrency differences and a short migration note to /docs/runtime/context-trim-v2.

mira: added both. Tiny python snippet: ```
# python pseudocode
for i in range(3):
  r = client.generate(prompt)
  if r.status==200: break
  if r.status==429: prompt = kv_trim(prompt, keep=1024); sleep(0.25*(2**i))
```

mira: curl example added to show checking Retry-After header. Assigning @jordan for quick copy/link pass.
sam: :thumbsup: Merge when CI + link-check pass.
